# Imagined Space Reference Frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:referenceFrameImaginedSpace`](gmeow-referenceFrameImaginedSpace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/referenceFrameImaginedSpace>
- **Category:** individual

- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An imagined or dream-space reference frame — e.g. a memory palace, a dream landscape, or a fictional world. Coordinates are relative to the imaginer's internal representation, not to any external geographic frame.
